task_instance: Migrate a tiny sample 2-page web React app (Next.js-style App Router: '/' and '/about') into an Expo native app shell, following the skill's steps 1-3: write migration-progress.md worklist, scaffold an Expo Router app with create-expo-app, and shell both web screens as 'use dom' components rendered by native routes (the 'day-one milestone' the skill defines as the core deliverable).
blocker_detail: Steps 1-3 (assess, scaffold, DOM-component shell) were fully produced and verified. Step 4 (native redesign with @expo/ui) and the skill's full 'verify by running' recipe (agent-browser + argent driving a live iOS/Android simulator or Expo Go on a device) were out of scope for a minimal instance and also not verifiable in this headless Linux container, which has no Xcode/adb/emulator/display -- that would be a missing_tool_in_runtime gap for the *full* multi-platform verification loop, but it did not block achieving the skill's core stated deliverable (a working Expo app that runs the migrated web UI).
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_fresh/expo__skills__expo-web-to-native/work . Created sample-web-app/src/app/{page.tsx,about/page.tsx} as the source web app. Wrote migration-progress.md (assess worklist bucketing both routes as port-as-is). Scaffolded native-shell/ via `npx create-expo-app@latest native-shell --template blank-typescript` (succeeded, 467 packages). Installed expo-router, react-native-webview, react-dom, react-native-web, @expo/metro-runtime (npm install --legacy-peer-deps, since `expo install`'s react-native-directory compatibility check hit a proxy-forbidden network error and aborted -- worked around by using npm directly). Set package.json main to 'expo-router/entry' and app.json plugins:['expo-router']. Created app/_layout.tsx (Stack), app/index.tsx and app/about/index.tsx as 'use dom' components with content ported directly from the sample web pages. Verified: `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` passed with no errors. `npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist` succeeded (774 modules bundled, produced dist/index.html and dist/_expo/static/js/web/entry-*.js, 1.1MB). Confirmed via grep that the bundled JS contains the migrated page content ('Acme Notes', 'About Acme Notes', 'Buy milk'). Served dist/ with `python3 -m http.server` and curl'd index.html (200, correct react-native-web HTML shell) and the JS bundle (200). This confirms the migrated DOM-component screens actually bundle and serve as a runnable Expo app, which is the skill's step-3 'day one' milestone ('shippable to TestFlight as-is'). Full on-device/simulator parity checking (skill's 'Verify by running, not compiling' section, which calls for agent-browser + argent against a live iOS/Android simulator) was not attempted since this sandbox has no Xcode, adb/emulator, or display.
